evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: Never asked. Rep moved directly into storage unit details without using the two-concerns framing.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: No concerns were probed at step 2, so no layers-deep follow-up occurred.
evidence_quotes.value_days: Rep stated 'we're already fully booked on the twenty fourth but we do have availability the next day, the twenty fifth' — acknowledged a date constraint but never offered value-days savings as a dollar amount or asked about flexibility.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_then_ask: Rep asked 'do you want to get this moved scheduled?' without any prior mention of rate lock or no-deposit promise. The ask came before any rate protection framing.

top_strength: Jules managed a complex multi-stop move with storage units and special items, gathered detailed logistics (storage sizes, piano, treadmill, printer specs), and identified the 800-pound printer limitation quickly — showing good product knowledge and problem-solving.
coaching_note: This call skipped the entire step 2 discovery framework (two-concerns question, active listening reflection) and step 3 promises, jumping straight into logistics — build the habit of opening with concerns and delivering On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Coverage before diving into details, and use value days with a dollar-amount save rather than just stating availability.
